top_story_headline: Pump.fun adjusts from 100% revenue to PUMP buybacks to 50/50 distribution after burning 36% of circulating supply, with half now automated via smart contract
top_story_comment: "Interesting move by Pump.fun. The 50/50 split suggests they're trying to balance short-term tokenomics with long-term sustainability. Chart shows PUMP bouncing off the 0.618 fib at $1.20 after the burn news, but struggling at the 20 EMA ($1.45). Volume is decent but needs to hold above $1.30 to confirm accumulation. Bear case: rejection here could see a retest of $1.00 support. Bull case: break and close above $1.50 opens up $1.80 (previous resistance). Watching RSI for divergence on the 4h."
